spellbook.finance/limitations: Deletion is owner-scoped and irreversible for the saved amendment. Read the amendment first when a retry is uncertain.
Deletion does not publish, reprice or restore a prior listing ask.

description: Delete one saved pricing amendment by exact amendment id and return a deletion readback. This changes saved configuration and does not publish or trigger repricing.

amendmentId.description: The exact saved amendment id from a prior amendment read. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_pricing_amendment_delete
